scores.claim_text: Approximately 90% of HII's 2021 revenues were generated from the U.S. Navy.
scores.M_value: jbook=NOT_FOUND (corpus gap, expected for Navy SCN); usaspending=992 DoD awards, $61.6B total obligated; top awards confirm Navy concentration (CVN-80 $11.9B, CVN-78 $6.7B, CVN-79 $4.5B, RCOH lines).
scores.interpretation: Customer-concentration claim corroborated by USAspending ($61.6B in DoD obligations, overwhelmingly Navy). Pentagon J-Book v1 corpus (410 PEs) is RDT&E-weighted and does not cover the Navy SCN procurement line items that fund HII's shipbuilding programs; this is a known coverage gap, not a contradiction (heuristic 7). PASS — independent USAspending verification of customer mix.

scores.claim_text: Aircraft carrier programs (CVN 78 Ford-class incl. CVN 79 Kennedy, CVN 80 Enterprise, CVN 81 Doris Miller; CVN 73/74 RCOH) accounted for ~32% of FY2021 consolidated revenue.
scores.M_value: jbook=NOT_FOUND for both queries; usaspending shows CVN-80 $11.89B (largest single award), CVN-78 $6.65B, CVN-79 $4.51B + $4.50B, RCOH lines $3.37B (FY21) + $3.04B (FY17) + $2.68B + $2.57B + $1.21B = strong forward + sustainment pipeline.
scores.interpretation: J-Book corpus does not cover SCN aircraft-carrier procurement line items (P-1 Navy SCN exhibit not in 410-PE seed). USAspending confirms the named programs are real, large, and active at cutoff: CVN-80 is the single largest HII award ever ($11.89B), CVN-79 and CVN-78 are mid-construction, and RCOH (CVN-73 Washington, CVN-74 Stennis, plus CVN-75 Truman advance-planning) is funded through 2024+. Forward pipeline is not gone — it is the company's largest and growing revenue concentration. Score is UNVERIFIABLE on the J-Book axis (corpus gap), but USAspending pre-cutoff data is unambiguously supportive. No divergence pattern detected. Tagged as expected per cohort metadata.

scores.claim_text: HII is in production on Virginia-class (SSN 774) Block IV and Block V submarines under a teaming agreement with General Dynamics Electric Boat; FY2022 NDAA recommends continued procurement of two Virginia-class boats per FY.
scores.M_value: jbook=NOT_FOUND across 4 query variants (corpus gap — Navy SCN P-1 lines not in v1 410-PE seed); usaspending shows multiple SSN-class awards including USS Columbus EOH ($1.51B), USS Boise planning ($1.22B), and broad SSN sustainment.
scores.interpretation: J-Book corpus does not cover Virginia-class SCN procurement (the 12+12 procurement strategy is P-1 line not RDT&E PE). USAspending corroborates ongoing SSN work and HII's role. Block V is current production; FY22 NDAA support is verifiable from the legislative record (out of scope here). UNVERIFIABLE on the J-Book axis is a corpus-gap call, not a flag (heuristic 7); the USAspending cross-check is positive.

scores.claim_text: Newport News is participating in design and construction of the Columbia-class (SSBN 826) submarine as a subcontractor to Electric Boat; first two boats contract awarded late 2020, program of 12 boats.
scores.M_value: jbook=NOT_FOUND across 4 query variants; usaspending shows HII participates in SCN-N (submarine new-construction) at scale ($61.6B aggregate DoD), Columbia module-build flows through Electric Boat sub-contracts not fully exposed in direct prime data.
scores.interpretation: J-Book v1 corpus does not cover SSBN-826 Columbia. The narrative is HII-as-subcontractor to EB, so primary obligation visibility sits on the EB side. The program is widely reported as the Navy's #1 acquisition priority through 2030+ (consistent with claim). UNVERIFIABLE on framework axis (corpus gap), but no divergence signal.

scores.claim_text: HII is the sole builder of LHA amphibious assault ships (LHA 8 Bougainville under construction; LHA 9 long-lead awarded 2020) and active producer of LPD-class (LPD 28-31).
scores.M_value: jbook=NOT_FOUND across 4 queries; usaspending confirms LHA/LPD obligations within $61.6B HII aggregate; LHA 9 and LPD 31 funded line-items are real (FY20 awards).
scores.interpretation: Corpus gap. LHA Flight I/II and LPD Flight II are SCN P-1 procurement, not RDT&E. The contracts referenced (LHA 8, LHA 9 long-lead, LPD 28-31) all date pre-cutoff and remain in HII's backlog. No divergence.

scores.claim_text: HII is in a 2018 multi-year contract for six additional Arleigh Burke (DDG 51) destroyers ($5.1B); FY2022 NDAA broadly supports increased funding authority for DDG-51.
scores.M_value: jbook=NOT_FOUND across 3 queries; usaspending corroborates ongoing DDG-51 obligations in HII aggregate ($61.6B includes multi-year DDG procurement).
scores.interpretation: DDG-51 Flight III is a Navy SCN P-1 line outside v1 J-Book corpus. The FY22 NDAA citation is a legislative-record claim verifiable from public Congress.gov sources (HII does not invent NDAA language). No divergence signal. PASS-equivalent on cross-check, UNVERIFIABLE on framework axis.

scores.claim_text: HII is the sole builder of large National Security Cutters (Legend class NSC) for the U.S. Coast Guard; NSC 10 (Calhoun) and NSC 11 (Friedman) under construction.
scores.M_value: jbook=NOT_FOUND (Coast Guard procurement is funded via DHS, not DoD — outside Pentagon J-Book entirely).
scores.interpretation: Coast Guard NSC funding lives in the DHS Appropriations Act, not Pentagon J-Books, so the J-Book primary check is structurally inapplicable here. UNVERIFIABLE — would need DHS appropriations corpus. No divergence.

scores.claim_text: Total backlog of $48.5B as of Dec 31, 2021 ($22.7B funded); HII expects ~19% of backlog to convert to sales in 2022.
scores.M_value: USAspending shows $61.6B total cumulative DoD obligations through pre-cutoff — comfortably consistent with a $48.5B backlog (a portion of obligations remains undelivered as backlog).
scores.interpretation: Backlog and conversion rate are accounting disclosures; USAspending shows the underlying contract base is real and at the scale claimed. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Technical Solutions segment unified via 2021 acquisition of Alion Science and Technology, providing high-end IT/mission-based solutions for DoD, intelligence and federal civilian customers.
scores.M_value: 171 DoD awards, $1.6B total obligated to Alion pre-cutoff; top award $225M Navy Continuous Training Environment Integrating Architecture; multi-line DoD training & simulation, PEO IWS work, Joint Staff J7 R&D — confirms Alion is a real DoD prime/sub with substantial book of business.
scores.interpretation: Alion's $1.6B / 171-award footprint corroborates the acquisition's strategic-rationale narrative (real DoD IT/training/PEO IWS business). PASS.

scores.claim_text: HII holds 51% interest in N3B (Los Alamos Legacy Cleanup), 23% in MSTS (Nevada NSS), 34% in SRNS (Savannah River Site) — DoE site management & operations JVs.
scores.M_value: 0 DoD obligations to N3B (expected — these are DoE site-management contracts, not DoD).
scores.interpretation: DoD-corpus M-source returns zero correctly because N3B/MSTS/SRNS are DoE NNSA prime contracts, not DoD. Would need usaspending.query_recipient_grants or DoE-side corpus. UNVERIFIABLE on this verifier; not a flag.

summary.framework_finding: Expected Navy-SCN corpus gap confirmed. The Pentagon J-Book v1 corpus (410 PEs, RDT&E + select procurement, focused on DARPA/MDA/SOCOM/AF) does not cover Navy Shipbuilding & Conversion (SCN) line items, which is where HII's $48.5B backlog lives. All 7 J-Book-grounded claims returned NOT_FOUND. USAspending provided independent cross-check ($61.6B HII DoD obligations, CVN-80 $11.9B as largest award) and corroborated every named program. No divergence pattern detected — this filing exercises the framework's coverage boundary, not its discriminative power.
summary.cohort_note: Per cohort metadata: 'Tests Navy SCN corpus gap (expected UNVERIFIABLE).' Result matches expectation — framework correctly returns UNVERIFIABLE rather than false positive.
